svg.aria-label: Career timeline at IBM Consulting, 2020 to now. 2020: Associate System Engineer, Ran a mission-critical tax engine through two platform migrations. 2021: Full Stack Developer, Built the front end of the pilot that launched an open-source migration program. 2022: Full Stack Developer, Owned architecture and estimates; made a 10k-row search instant. 2023: Senior Full Stack Developer, Set up CI/CD and standards, then shipped the program's first SSO. 2024: Tech Lead, Cut a 20-minute data compile to seconds; delivered a month early. 2025: Tech Lead, Designed the execution framework; batch jobs up to 55% faster.
